name: SNOOD
fix_description: In _spendAllowance, do not call _getStandardAmount on the amount parameter. Allowances are token-denominated, so pass amount directly to super._spendAllowance without reflection conversion. The conversion causes the amount to round to 0, bypassing the allowance check entirely.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct reserve-manipulation exploit against a Uniswap-style pair using an obvious token flaw: the PoC simply transfers tokens out of the LP, calls sync, returns them, then swaps for WETH. It involves only a couple of contract interactions, no flash loan or deep protocol reasoning, and a competent auditor could write it quickly once noticing the pair token can be pulled from the LP.
